text:
mara: Quick sync re: recurring KV-cache + routing incidents. We have action items in PM but need firm owners and automated tests so we dont drift.

eli: TL;DR: two incidents in 5 months with same pattern: eviction spikes + router bumps => transient 3x p95 token latency, some 5xxs. We need deterministic repro + CI gates.

jamie: I can own a deterministic regression that replays eviction events and router flaps against a lightweight test harness. Suggest param-driven job that runs on PRs touching routing/kv.

nina: Ill curate a prompt regression pack pulled from the incidents that surfaced degraded outputs. Will add expected tokens and fuzzy match rules. Storing under `redwood/evals/incident-2026-q1.csv`. ETA 12 days.

carlos: Perf will add a targeted scenario to our load suite: KV-miss focused profile + short burst (8m ramp). Will produce p50/p95/p99 baselines and a regression alert if any change >10%. ETA 6 days.

mara: Ownership summary to post in the board:
- JAMIE: regression harness + CI job name `ci/regress/kv-router`. ETA 1wk.
- NINA: prompt pack + metadata. ETA 12d.
- CARLOS: k6 load profile + baseline. ETA 6d.
- ELI: update postmortem with acceptance criteria and link tests. ETA 3d.

eli: Proposed acceptance criteria: prompt regression >=98% (fuzzy pass), p95 token latency on KV-miss profile <=210ms, CI regression must reproduce failure sequence locally in under 10m.

jamie: Will add smoke checks and an option to run the harness as a local debug script. Will open GH issue and link reviewers @mara @eli.

nina: Prompt CSV sample: `inc_id,input,expected_subset`
`2026-03-23-17,"Explain the billing change","billing,prorate"`. Ill tag the original log id for traceability.

carlos: k6 snippet (sketch):
```js
// simulate KV miss-heavy clients
export default function(){http.post('/v1/generate', payload);sleep(0.03);}
```
Will attach graphs to the perf PR.

eli: Also: add metric alerts for "prefix_eviction_rate" and a 30s heartbeat for routers. If eviction rate > X for 60s, page oncall.

jamie: Recommend a quarterly chaos drill that intentionally evicts prefix cache and toggles a router to validate runbook. Start with tabletop next month.

ops-bot: Tabletop scheduled 2026-04-06 15:00 UTC. Invitees: @eng-ml, @eng-sre.

mara: Ok. Please drop GH/PR links here as you create them. Ill update the incident board and schedule the follow-up check-in in 8 days.

nina: Uploading initial prompt pack by EoD Wed.

carlos: Perf PR in 6 days.

jamie: Issue + initial PR in 2 days.

mara: Thanks all, closing thread for now. Will post summary to #engineering-ops once board is updated. :white_check_mark:
